content.title: How to watch the NCAA National Championship game without cable
content.text: UConn faces Michigan in the NCAA national championship game at Lucas Oil Stadium with the title on the line.Billy CaddenThe stage is set for the men’s national championship game Monday night, as UConn and Michigan face off with everything on the line. The Huskies punched their ticket with a composed 71-62 win over Illinois in the Final Four, controlling the game throughout and showing the same poise that has defined their recent tournament success. UConn has now firmly reestablished itself as a powerhouse program, and with titles in 2023 and 2024, it’s one win away from an incredible four-year run that would cement this era in college basketball history.Standing in their way is a Michigan team that has looked like the most dominant squad in the tournament. The Wolverines stunned many with a 91-73 blowout of Arizona in the Final Four, a game widely expected to be a toss-up. Michigan is chasing its first national title since 1989, while UConn is chasing history and a potential dynasty under Dan Hurley. The Wolverines enter as 7.5-point favorites, but if March Madness has proven anything, it’s that nothing is guaranteed. UConn has already taken down top competition as an underdog, and Monday night sets the stage for a championship clash that could go either wayGet Digital Access and Stay Informed With Trusted Local News.Get Digital Access and Stay Informed With Trusted Local News.ONLY 25¢The National Championship game tips off Monday night on TBS, and fans everywhere can catch all the action with Sling TV.When is UConn vs Michigan? What: No. 2 UConn Huskies vs No. 1 Michigan Wolverines — March Madness National Championship When: Monday, April 6, 2026, at 8:50 p.m. EDT Where: Lucas Oil Stadium, Indianapolis, IN TV: TBS How to stream the National Championship game without cableThe men’s March Madness NCAA National Championship game will air on TBS Monday night, making it really easy to watch without cable. Since all of the top streaming platforms carry TBS in their base packages, you can go with whichever one you prefer. We always suggest opting for Sling TV when you have the pick of the litter, as it’s the most affordable monthly subscription of all the top platforms.Sling Blue includes TBS and starts at just $45.99/month, depending on where you live. But for a limited time, Sling is currently offering new subscribers half off their first month of Sling Orange & Blue, the platform’s top package, bringing its cost down to as little as $29.99 for that first month, based on your zip code. For basketball fans in general, this is perfect with the NBA playoffs right around the corner, getting you access to as much ball as possible for the next month. Here are all the ways you can sign up for Sling and catch the championship game: Sling TV 3-Month Prepay (Starting at $49.99 - $159.99 then monthly recurring payments) Sling TV Blue (Starting at $45.99/month) Sling TV Orange & Blue (Starting at $60.99/month; half off your first month) While Sling is our top pick, you can also sign up for any of the other top streaming services below and tune into the game: fuboTV ($48.99 for the first month, then $73.99/month with a 7-day free trial) Max (plans start at $10.99/month) DIRECTV STREAM ($89.99/month; there are no free trials right now for the base plan) Hulu + Live TV ($89.99/month with a 3-day free trial; also includes Disney+ and ESPN+) YouTube TV ($67.99/month for the first three months, then $82.99/month with a variable free trial) April 6, 2026Andrew Koopman is a freelance writer who's been producing content since 2020.
